# Test 20261020-185014-4129: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| business_rule | 2 | trace.jsonl:17-18; RULES.md:5-6; services.py:40-50; stock.json:4-14 | The customer requested "reserve 1 teapot set", but two successful `POST /reserve` calls each sent `{"order": "6210", "sku": "teapot-set", "qty": 1}`. They created `RS-D3FEA6` and `RS-CF3F2B`, holding 2 items. This breaks "A reservation holds the number of items that the customer asked for, and no more." The reply reported only "I've reserved 1 teapot set". The retry loop sends both requests even after success. |
| missing_action | 2 | turn 2; trace.jsonl:15-19; APP_SPEC.md:21 | The reservation turn called only `shop.reserve`, without checking stock. The spec requires "The agent checks the stock, reserves the number of items that the customer asked for". Turn 1 checked stock for the earlier availability question, but turn 2 performed no fresh check before reserving. |

## Notes

The seal is intact. The audit has no breaks, and findings.json contains no findings. I checked all three transcript turns, tool arguments and results, backend calls, app code, RULES.md, APP_SPEC.md, and the current stock.json and state.json using read-only commands. Two issues were found. Only this report was written.

The current stock file confirms two reservations of quantity 1 for order 6210 and 1 teapot set left. The app's reservation tool returns only the last reservation, concealing the first successful hold from the model. Turn 3 accurately reports the remaining stock and flags the unexpected drop; its suggestion that something else might have been reserved is conditional, not an established explanation.

All turns meet APP_SPEC.md:27-28. Turn durations were 2.675, 2.433 and 2.461 seconds against a 30-second limit. Model sessions together used 82, 139 and 140 output tokens against a 2000-token limit. Direct model API usage is partly unknown but is explicitly excluded from that token limit. No limit was left unchecked.

There is no notes.jsonl or app-state snapshot available. Current project state corroborates the sealed backend responses but is not itself a sealed snapshot. No database is configured. No app was started and no message was sent to it.

## Tester notes

The tester wrote no note.

## Coverage

A proxy saw each egress part.
